decisions.rationale: Market stall, 2.6 x 4 m, four posts, a plank counter with boxed goods and a back board under a sloping plank roof, front 2.6 m, back 3.2 m; 152 triangles, 14,380 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: Goods are plain boxes in the kit layers; no cloth, produce or awnings.
Every stall is the same model; only the placement varies.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Settlement squares (two or three per market) at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
